_doc: COCHRANE HEAD-TO-HEAD (the #1 external-validation item, attempted against the gold standard). Topic: metformin vs placebo for ovulation in PCOS, vs Cochrane review CD013505 (Sharpe/Morley). Compares trial list and numbers to a hand-built Cochrane extraction.
cochrane_review: CD013505 Metformin for ovulation induction in PCOS
FINDINGS: PER-TRIAL NUMBER-BY-NUMBER IS BLOCKED even for the gold standard: Cochrane states per-woman ovulation ARM COUNTS (the forest-plot Analysis 1.4 data) nowhere in its OA full text — they live in forest-plot IMAGES. Only per-CYCLE data appears in Table 6 for 11 trials. So a text-only per-trial head-to-head cannot be run against Cochrane; per-trial ground truth needs vision/OCR or IPD. This is a concrete research-agenda finding.

POOLED-LEVEL: Cochrane OR 2.64 (k=13) vs OURS OR 8.25 (k=1). Our single trial (PMID 11172832) is far from the 13-trial pool — a stark, honest illustration of the small-k weakness: a k=1 estimate is unreliable against a proper pool. Directly motivates the larger-evidence-base expansion tier.

TRIAL-LIST: Cochrane includes 18 metformin-vs-placebo trials (13 with ovulation in the pool); we include 1. The gap is our strict eligibility (and a possible metformin+clomiphene-vs-metformin-alone scope difference to verify).

cochrane_trials.label: Baillargeon 2004
cochrane_trials.note: Included in the review's 18 trials comparing metformin alone with placebo/no treatment. Per-woman ovulation arm counts/effect for Analysis 1.4 are not stated in the text. Table 6 states per-cycle data only: metformin 27/32 cycles, placebo 11/32 cycles, P < 0.01.

cochrane_trials.note: Included in the review's 18 trials comparing metformin alone with placebo/no treatment. Characteristics list ovulation as an outcome, but per-woman ovulation arm counts/effect are not stated in the text.

cochrane_trials.note: Included in the review's 18 trials comparing metformin alone with placebo/no treatment. Per-woman ovulation arm counts/effect for Analysis 1.4 are not stated in the text.
